🛂 MI HB 6158 — Michigan Limits Federal Access to State Buildings

Michigan is now blocking state and local governments from letting federal immigration officers enter nonpublic areas without a court order, protecting privacy and limiting potential federal intrusion.

July 14, 2026: Bill electronically reproduced 07/03/2026.

🔗 Read the full bill: https://legislature.mi.gov/Bills/Bill?ObjectName=2026-HB-6158
